value.title: Situation Love Handicap
value.synopsis: An unaired episode included in the Toshokan Sensou DVD volume 3, adapts chapters from the novel that would have become episode 6. Komaki was arrested for the violation of human rights of his girl friend Marie, who had difficulty in hearing.He was kept in custody and tortured by the Media Improvement Forces. The members of the Task Forces made a desperate effort to rescue him.
